definition: Add a remote MCP server by URL through Settings > Connectors.
outcome: a remote MCP server the user supplied by URL is listed as a connector in this product and can be turned on in chats

records.outcome: on a Team or Enterprise plan, the owner has added the remote MCP server URL as a Custom connector in organization settings, so members can find and connect it
steps: If asked for the connector type, choose Web
Enter the remote MCP server URL
Optionally configure OAuth Client ID/Secret in Advanced settings

evidence.quote: Select **Add**, then **Custom**. If Claude asks for the connector type, choose **Web**.

records.notes: Owner stage of the two-actor Team/Enterprise path; the member stage is the next record. Could alternatively be read as T-022, since no member connector is connected by this step.

records.outcome: the member is authenticated to the owner-added Custom connector and can use it
preconditions: an owner has already added the custom connector
steps: Find the connector with the "Custom" label
records.notes: Member stage of the Team/Enterprise path.

records.outcome: a remote MCP server supplied by URL is listed as a custom connector on the user's own account
steps: Enter the remote MCP server URL

evidence.anchor: ### For Free, Pro, and Max plans

records.notes: A two-step version of the dialog is rolling out; its fields are described under "The Add custom connector dialog, field by field", which is descriptive rather than a procedure.
